topics.mining: Use any pickaxe to get cobbled deepslate. A Silk Touch pickaxe collects deepslate itself. Without a pickaxe it drops nothing; Fortune does not increase the drop.
topics.location: Deepslate makes up most solid terrain below Y=0 in the Overworld. It gradually replaces stone between Y=8 and Y=0.

topics.mining: Dirt drops itself by hand or with any tool; a shovel is fastest. Silk Touch is unnecessary and Fortune does not increase the drop.

topics.water: Use a water bottle on dirt to turn it into mud. Simply placing dirt next to water does not do this.
